title: Sacrifice the Shelter
setup: The black king on f8 has one pawn left in front of it, and your bishop on d4 aims straight at it.
hint: The pawn beside the king looks like a guard. Ask what your bishop covers on the square behind it.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Qxg7+}} works because the bishop on **d4** defends g7, so the king cannot take. {{Ke8}} is the only square left, and now the queen rakes the seventh rank while {{Rc8#}} claims the eighth. Two lines, no escape.
